scientific_integrity: A self-contained all-length proof is supplied; cited general lemmas and limitations are identified, and the computational checks are independent of the counting formula.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to binary directed necklaces containing exactly three occurrences of one.
The result does not classify words with more marked symbols, nonbinary alphabets, or reversal-equivalence classes.
The strict-chord converse is not valid for all binary words; a known five-one counterexample is cited.
Finite checker results are corroboration, not a proof of infinite claims.
Historical priority remains subject to an earlier equivalent theorem under different terminology.
title: Weakly Abelian unbordered conjugates of three-marker binary necklaces
